steps.js: await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300)); const t=[...document.querySelectorAll('.toasts > .toast, [class*=undo]')].filter(e=>e.getBoundingClientRect().width>0); const btn=t.flatMap(e=>[...e.querySelectorAll('button')]).find(b=>/撤销/.test(b.innerText)); if(!btn) return {toasts:t.map(e=>e.innerText.replace(/\s+/g,' ').slice(0,50))}; const r=btn.getBoundingClientRect(); const h=document.elementFromPoint(r.x+r.width/2,r.y+r.height/2); return {toast:t.map(e=>e.innerText.replace(/\s+/g,' ').slice(0,50)), undoBtn:btn.innerText.trim(), clickable:btn.contains(h)};
const t=document.body.innerText; return {logout:/登出|退出登录/.test(t), account:(t.match(/[^\n]*(查看者|项目方|账户)[^\n]*/g)||[]).slice(0,3)}
const p=document.querySelector('.v3-pop, [role=menu], [role=dialog]'); return p? p.innerText.replace(/\s+/g,' ').slice(0,200) : 'no popup'

const m=document.querySelector('main.v3-page')||document.scrollingElement; const sp=getComputedStyle(m).scrollPaddingTop; const sticky=[...document.querySelectorAll('*')].filter(e=>getComputedStyle(e).position==='sticky' && e.getBoundingClientRect().height>0 && e.getBoundingClientRect().width>innerWidth*0.3); const hs=sticky.map(e=>Math.round(e.getBoundingClientRect().height)); const btns=[...m.querySelectorAll('button')].filter(b=>b.offsetParent && b.innerText.trim() && b.getBoundingClientRect().top>innerHeight+100); const out=[]; for(const b of btns.slice(0,3)){ m.scrollTop=m.scrollHeight; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,200)); b.focus(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300)); const r=b.getBoundingClientRect(); const h=document.elementFromPoint(r.x+r.width/2,r.y+Math.min(8,r.height/2)); out.push({t:b.innerText.trim().slice(0,8), top:Math.round(r.top), hitSelf:b.contains(h)}); } return {scrollPaddingTop:sp, stickyHeights:hs, focus:out};
